backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles with access control, allowing users and admins to view or update profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report showing which files implement the Google Search Console verification meta tag.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining color tokens and dark mode styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point including Google Search Console verification meta tag and script bootstrapping the app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React app router setup with routes and shared layout containing header and footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Empty placeholder file for an authentication button component.
frontend/src/components/brief/BriefPrevi: Empty placeholder file for brief preview UI component.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer component with company info, navigation links, services list, and social/contact links.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Responsive header with logo, desktop and mobile navigation, and quote button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing a backend actor tied to Internet Identity with access control initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for Internet Identity login, logout, and identity lifecycle management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the current user's profile using an actor instance.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes along with scrollbar and grid pattern styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission, vision, values, team details, milestones, and company story sections.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with submission handling and displays contact information cards.
frontend/src/pages/FacilitiesPage.tsx: Displays facility details and specifications including capacity, temperature ranges, features, and infrastructure stats.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Builds the homepage featuring a hero section, stats, and key service features for the cold storage business.
frontend/src/pages/ServicesPage.tsx: Renders a services page displaying various cold‑storage offerings with icons, descriptions, features, and certifications using UI cards and badges.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helper functions to read, store, retrieve, and clear URL and sessionStorage parameters, including support for hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, container settings, and plugins for styling the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including versioning, feature list, requirements mappings, and overall state summary.
